This is a rule-19 [R-ONE-MECH] CONSTRUCTION REPAIR of a seam between two existing mechanisms (cc_capacity_reconcile, which removes MW a plant's fleet rows over-state, and cc_nameplate_summer_derate, which then derates the REMAINING capacity by a ratio referenced to the FULL nameplate) -- the two were composing multiplicatively and removing the same MW twice. Zero new or retuned constants; the field is a bool; both operands (EIA-860 net summer capability, EIA-860 nameplate) are published measured inputs already in the tree, and the carried capacity is the model's own fleet sum. Nothing is selected, swept or tuned, and no residual enters the construction. PROVENANCE OF THE RE-SCREEN: nyiso-212 built the mechanism and screened it on 2025, then KILLED its own arm on the literal reading of two gates whose wording was its own -- refusing to rewrite a bar after seeing the number -- and left the span unspent. The corrected S-2(c) is STRICTER IN COVERAGE than the bar it replaces (all 15 reconciled plants bounded individually by their own measured ceiling delta, versus 3 under the mode-label bar) and could still have killed the arm.
